analysis.summary:
ISSUES
Critical:
- The "How It Works" page failed the web performance test. It is crucial to investigate and resolve the issues causing this failure to ensure a smooth user experience.
insights: The homepage has the longest load time (582 ms) among the passed tests, which could be improved. However, it is still within an acceptable range.
The blog page has the lowest First Contentful Paint (FCP) time (160.5 ms), indicating that it renders the first bit of content quickly. This is a positive sign of good performance.

The pricing page has the shortest overall duration (888 ms) and load time (177.5 ms), making it the fastest-loading page among the passed tests. It could serve as a benchmark for improving the performance of other pages.
Investigating and addressing the issues causing the "How It Works" page to fail the web performance test should be a priority to ensure consistent performance across all pages.
